commitMessage: fix: IsMax BOOL output type in EvaluationCalibration and Transforms
notes: All eval tests now pass. Fix: IsMax C++ op requires BOOL output type. EvaluationCalibration.eval() was passing p.ulike() (same type as input, e.g. DOUBLE/FLOAT) as output array. Fixed to allocate DataType.BOOL output and castTo(p.dataType()) for downstream arithmetic (sum, mask). Also fixed Transforms.isMax() static methods. Suites: EvalJsonTest(5), RegressionEvalTest(10+3), ROCTest(20+1), EvaluationToolsTests(3). 1 skip in ROCTest (known).
